1. History NCERT
Ancient, Medieval, Modern & Freedom Struggle. Oswaal Ch 1–30.
2. Geography NCERT
Physical Geomorphology, Oceanography, Climate & Indian Drainage. Ch 1–10+.
3. Polity NCERT
Constitutional Framework, Articles 1–51A, Parliament, Executive, Judiciary & Bodies.
4. Economy NCERT
Macro Basics, GDP/NNP, Money & Banking, RBI Tools, Inflation, Budget & BoP. Ch 1–8.
5. General Science
Human Physiology, Cell Biology, Diseases, Space, Defence Tech, Biotech & Ecology.

Grand GS Mistake Notebook & Tricky MCQs

Consolidated list of questions, formulas, and concepts that need extra drills.

Economy
Primary Deficit Formula

Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit - Interest Payments. (Do not confuse with Revenue Deficit!)

Polity
High Court Writ vs Supreme Court Writ

Art 226 (HC) is broader than Art 32 (SC) because HC can issue writs for legal rights in addition to fundamental rights.

Geography
Atmospheric Layers Temperature

Troposphere: temp decreases with height. Stratosphere: temp increases with height due to ozone UV absorption.

Desktop & Laptop App

Install on Your Laptop for Offline Study

You can run this app just like any desktop program (Windows, Mac, Linux) with a single click, or download the self-contained HTML file to your desktop!

Google Chrome & Brave

  1. Look at the top URL address bar on the right side.
  2. Click the small Install Icon (or computer screen icon with a down arrow).
  3. Click Install when prompted. The app will launch in its own native laptop window!

Microsoft Edge (Windows)

  1. Click the App available icon in the address bar.
  2. Or click the 3 dots (···) on top right → Apps → Install UPSC Master.
  3. Pin to your Windows Taskbar or Desktop for 1-click launch!

Mac Safari / Standalone File

  1. On Mac Safari: click File in menu bar → Add to Dock.
  2. Or click Download Desktop App (.html) button above.
  3. Save the downloaded file on your Desktop. Double-click it anytime to open offline without internet!

Data Persistence & Backup

All your chapter completions, notes, mistake logs, and alarm settings are stored securely in your laptop's browser memory. You can export a backup file anytime!
